components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-filter{font-family:'Albert Sans', 'ROUND Sans SC', sans-serif;font-weight:400;border:1px solid var(--line,#d8d9db);border-radius:40px;padding:14px 24px;min-height:52px;font-size:14px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);cursor:pointer;transition:background .3s,color .3s}.ds-filter[aria-pressed=true],.ds-filter:hover{background:var(--ink,#1c1d20);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink,#1c1d20)}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#455ce9);outline-offset:7px}@media(hover:none){.ds-filter:hover:not([aria-pressed=true]){background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);border-color:var(--line,#d8d9db)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-filter{transition:none}}

components.name: Underlined note search
components.description: A visible label and a blue focus rule on an otherwise open field.
components.css: .ds-search-label{font-family:'Albert Sans', 'ROUND Sans SC', sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20)}.ds-search{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink,#1c1d20);padding:18px 0;margin-top:8px;max-width:550px}.ds-search input{font-family:'Albert Sans', 'ROUND Sans SC', sans-serif;font-weight:400;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);width:100%;min-width:0;font-size:20px;border-radius:0;caret-color:var(--blue,#455ce9)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#606267);opacity:1}.ds-search input:focus{outline:none}.ds-search:focus-within{border-bottom:2px solid var(--blue,#455ce9)}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-nav a{font-family:'Albert Sans', 'ROUND Sans SC', sans-serif;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);position:relative;padding:12px 0;font-size:16px;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-2px;left:50%;width:5px;height:5px;background:currentColor;border-radius:50%;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .3s}.ds-nav a:hover::after{transform:scale(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#455ce9);outline-offset:7px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a::after{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-work-row{font-family:'Albert Sans', 'ROUND Sans SC', sans-serif;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d8d9db);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d8d9db);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;padding:55px 8vw;min-height:165px;text-decoration:none;transition:color .3s}.ds-work-row h3{font-size:clamp(36px,4.6vw,70px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0;flex:1;transition:transform .6s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))}.ds-work-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;transition:transform .6s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))}.ds-work-meta small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#606267)}.ds-work-row:hover{color:#919296}.ds-work-row:hover h3{transform:translateX(-20px)}.ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-meta{transform:translateX(20px)}.ds-work-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#455ce9);outline-offset:7px}@media(max-width:400px){.ds-work-row{padding:25px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-work-row,.ds-work-row h3,.ds-work-meta{transition:none;transform:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
ROUND’s visual world places real encounters inside a spacious portfolio frame: white reading surfaces, charcoal invitations, oversized regular-weight type and blue circular actions. The user-selected Dennis Snellenberg reference supplies the visual and interaction language; ROUND’s original photographs, identity and activity material supply its content.

The system feels open, photographic and gently elastic. Circles appear as actions, portraits, menu controls and navigation marks; rectangular images and hairline divisions keep the surrounding material quiet. Motion connects these forms through a moving wordmark, curved transitions and restrained pointer feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Authentic activity photography with generous surrounding space.
Regular-weight Albert Sans paired with the locally hosted ROUND Sans SC Chinese face.
Flat white and charcoal surfaces, with blue reserved for interaction.
Circular actions, pill outlines, rectangular image fields and hairline rows.
Responsive layouts with explicit touch controls and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Blue Action Rule
rules.body: Use blue for interactive emphasis: action discs, hover fills, selection and focus. Preserve neutral reading surfaces.

rules.name: The Open Type Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy through scale and space while retaining regular weight. Give Chinese prose its observed generous line height.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use contrast, hairlines, photography and overlapping shapes for depth; the implemented system has no box shadows.

dos: Do use the original ROUND photographs and preserve their source context.
Do retain regular-weight Albert Sans and the locally hosted ROUND Sans SC Chinese face.
Do pair circular actions with open, flat reading surfaces and hairline divisions.
Do keep the mobile image and action visible without requiring hover.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, meaningful button labels, menu focus containment and photo-viewer keyboard controls.
Do respect reduced motion and the explicit motion pause control.
donts: Don’t import the reference creator’s identity, portrait or project content into ROUND.
Don’t turn archival activity information into invented live booking promises.
Don’t replace the photographic portfolio with an inherited scrapbook composition.
Don’t add shadows or rounded card shells to the existing flat image-and-rule patterns.
Don’t make cursor-following previews the only way to see an activity.
